misprints.note: το has no accent and there is a full stop after ἡ.
No accent is printed on παρα.
αυξ- has no breathing in either place, and the second has no closing parenthesis.

misprints.printed: τὰ πρὸς τον βίον ... τα πρὸς τον βίον
misprints.note: τον and the second τα have no accents.
Possibly a Doric or misprinted form of σημύδα, birch.

uncertain.note: The η of τῆς under Nålsöga is broken and looks like τ̃ις.
The scan clearly shows κέαρ. τος, but the sense is odd. Copied as printed.
The iota subscript under the final η is only a faint blob at the edge of the line.
The accent on ω is the hooked form this face uses for circumflex. I also changed χειρὼν to χειρῶν in strip 00 on the same evidence: τῶν, which must take a circumflex, shows the same hook.
The ink is faint, so the accent and breathing are barely visible.

uncertain.text: Nålsöga. / Näbbformig. / Näbbig. / Närbelägen. / Närig. / Näringsfrihet. / Näringslös.
uncertain.note: These headwords end in a low dot rather than a clear comma, so I wrote a full stop. Some may be broken commas.
